using System;
using System.Net;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Server.Replication.ReplicaOps.Tests
{
    public class ReplicaReceiveCheckpointTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task ReplicaSyncAttachTaskAsync_LogsError_WhenNoPrimaryAssigned()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ReplicationManager>>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<IClusterProvider>(); // Simplified mock
            var mockClusterManager = new Mock<IClusterManager>();
            var mockCurrentConfig = new Mock<IClusterConfig>();
            
            mockCurrentConfig.Setup(c => c.GetLocalNodePrimaryAddress()).Returns((null, -1));
            mockClusterManager.Setup(m => m.CurrentConfig).Returns(mockCurrentConfig.Object);
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(p => p.clusterManager).Returns(mockClusterManager.Object);

            // Create ReplicationManager instance - minimal constructor for test
            var replicationManager = new ReplicationManagerTestFixture(mockLogger.Object, mockClusterProvider.Object);

            // Act
            var result = await replicationManager.CallReplicaSyncAttachTaskAsync(false, false);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(s => s.ToString().Contains("RESP_ERR_GENERIC_NOT_ASSIGNED_PRIMARY_ERROR")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
            
            Assert.NotNull(result);
            Assert.Contains("NOT_ASSIGNED_PRIMARY_ERROR", result);
        }
    }

    // Minimal test fixture to enable calling the private method
    public class ReplicationManagerTestFixture : ReplicationManager
    {
        public ReplicationManagerTestFixture(ILogger<ReplicationManager> logger, IClusterProvider clusterProvider) 
            : base(logger, clusterProvider) { }

        public async Task<string> CallReplicaSyncAttachTaskAsync(bool downgradeLock, bool forceAsync)
        {
            return await ReplicaSyncAttachTaskAsync(downgradeLock, forceAsync);
        }
    }
}
